**People and roles.** Invite people to your panel with a one-time link from the new **People** page in the sidebar, as an **Admin**, **Operator** or **Viewer**, for one server or all of them. They pick a name, create a passkey and save recovery codes, and see only the servers you gave them. Change what someone can do or remove them at any time, and it applies straight away. Viewers see status and who's online, not the console. You become the **Owner** when you update. See [People and roles](https://github.com/MattA-Official/mc-panel/blob/v1.2.0-beta.3/docs/people.md).

**Custom roles.** Make your own roles from a list of permissions, such as a Moderator who can read the console and manage players. People only see what they can use: tabs and buttons they can't use are hidden, and **View only** shows where they can look but not change.

**Your account.** Click your name at the bottom of the sidebar for your own settings: change your name, choose light, dark or follow-the-device (remembered on every device), manage your passkeys and recovery codes, and sign out everywhere else. SSH has moved to its own section in **System**.

**Setup by link.** The installer now prints a setup link as well as the setup token, so first-time setup is one click. Typing the token still works where the link can't be opened.

Testing notes are in the "People and roles" section of [testing-1.2.0.md](https://github.com/MattA-Official/mc-panel/blob/v1.2.0-beta.3/docs/testing-1.2.0.md).
